designationHistory.name: Niobrara Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: William Howard Taft signed Executive Order 1461 reserving public land of the former Fort Niobrara military reservation in Nebraska as a preserve and breeding ground for native birds.
designationHistory.note: CCP gives 13,279 acres (not rechecked). A later order of November 14, 1912 enlarged its purpose to big game (CCP). Renamed Fort Niobrara National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416 (July 25, 1940).

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Fort Niobrara NWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan, 1999 (ServCat 5982)
